ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISNEW(), RecordType.Name = 'Fin Ops Approval', NOT(ISBLANK(Opportunity__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT( Opportunity__r.Fin_Opp_Approval__c ))), ISPICKVAL ( Opportunity__r.Fin_Opp_Approval__c , "Approved") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: There is an existing approved Fin Ops approval. You are not allowed to create another Fin Ops approval. If you would like to submit a new Fin Ops approval, please recall the existing approved approval.
